non_negotiable_invariants: The EvidenceCandidateExtractor protocol remains the only extraction interface consumed by orchestration.
ExtractionResponse and extraction_response_model_for remain the canonical provider-facing and locally validated structured-output contracts.
All providers receive only policy-requested evidence facts; CASE_METADATA facts remain on the deterministic metadata route.
TEXT and VISUAL evidence references remain a discriminated union and cannot mix supporting_text with visual_observation.
Text citations must continue to match supplied canonical page text under the existing deterministic normalization rules.
Every response must cover exactly the requested facts in the requested order.
No provider response is partially admitted, repaired, coerced, or supplemented.
NOT_FOUND remains insufficient evidence and never becomes evidence of the opposite.
Requirement evaluation and recommendation generation remain deterministic and provider-independent.
Provider selection is exact and configuration-driven; no automatic routing, substitution, fallback, or cross-provider retry is permitted.
Provider/model incompatibility fails closed rather than weakening the schema or prompt.
API keys remain SecretStr values and must never appear in logs, exceptions, execution identity, SQLite, temporary filenames, or committed artifacts.
Existing Nebius fact-extraction request shape, fact adapter, endpoint default, prompt version, schema version, parameters, errors, and admitted results remain unchanged.

The image-description boundary is strengthened uniformly for Nebius, OpenAI, and Anthropic: written text, visible pixels, and limitations are separate structured fields before deterministic rendering into existing EvidencePage text.

Live model wording and extracted values may differ; the cross-provider invariant is identical evidence scope, instructions, canonical candidate shape, and deterministic admission and decision treatment.
Existing policies, rulebooks, database schemas, persisted results, UI behaviour, CLI behaviour, and cached reopening remain unchanged.
No live provider call is made during the ordinary test suite.

visual_observation_contract.purpose: Describe image-derived source material without collapsing written claims, visible pixels, and epistemic limitations into one free-form description.

written_text_observations.meaning: Text visibly written in the image, copied faithfully and treated as a written assertion rather than as pixel-established truth.

visible_pixel_observations.meaning: Conservative descriptions of objects, colours, orientation, and other directly visible pixels.

limitations.meaning: What the supplied view cannot establish, including hidden condition, operation, completeness, comparison, causality, or off-camera content.

pydantic_rules: Every field is required even when an observation tuple is empty.
Every item must be a non-blank bounded string.
Duplicate items within a field are rejected.
The provider response is rejected as a whole on any schema failure; no section is repaired or partially admitted.
provider_neutral_rendering: Validate the native provider response as VisionObservationResult.
Render the three fields deterministically, in fixed section order, into the existing EvidencePage.text boundary.
Do not change EvidenceDocument persistence or historical converted documents.
Bump the image converter/prompt/schema version so new structured conversions cannot be confused with earlier cached image descriptions.
Preserve exact written observations in canonical page text so later TEXT citations must copy from supplied canonical text.
Keep visible pixel observations eligible only for VISUAL provenance.

definition_of_done: PROVIDER_FACTORIES contains exactly nebius, openai, and anthropic.
Nebius fact extraction uses the same class, request shape, prompt, schema, parameters, endpoint default, and validation behaviour as the approved baseline.

All three vision routes validate VisionObservationResult, preserve written text separately from visible pixels, require limitations, and deterministically render into the existing EvidencePage.text boundary under a new converter version.
The CB-2025-0006 shared image contract proves that a caption claim, direct pixel observation, and view limitations remain distinct and do not establish hidden condition.
OpenAI uses the native Responses adapter with no Chat Completions or compatible-endpoint fallback.
Anthropic uses the native Messages API with exact JSON Schema structured output and native base64 image blocks.
All three adapters implement EvidenceCandidateExtractor and return the same canonical ExtractionCandidate tuple shape.
All three adapters encounter the same canonical schema, coverage, citation, source-scope, provenance, type, and cardinality boundaries.
Documentation and tests define provider equivalence as identical deterministic treatment, not identical independently generated live facts or wording.
Unsupported or incompatible providers fail clearly before any partial downstream result.
Execution lineage records exact non-secret provider, model, adapter, prompt version, schema version, and material parameters.
No API key appears in source, logs, errors, identity, SQLite, temporary artifact names, fixtures, or test output.
All existing v4 fixture-backed case outcomes remain unchanged.
Existing persisted results reopen without migration and without a provider call.
The complete ordinary regression suite passes.
The gated Nebius transport contract passes after the change.
A provider is called LIVE_VALIDATED only after CB-2025-0004, CB-2025-0006, and CB-2025-0007 all complete through that real provider and satisfy the qualification conditions.
Any provider lacking a completed qualification pack is labelled IMPLEMENTED_AND_CONTRACT_TESTED_NOT_LIVE_VALIDATED; an attempted failure is labelled LIVE_VALIDATION_FAILED.
